articles.title_en: Information Acquisition and Product Differentiation Perception
articles.title_cn: 信息获取与产品差异化感知
articles.abstract_en: We consider the equilibrium interplay between sellers' price competition and consumers' perception of product differentiation. We analyze a situation where, before trading, consumers acquire information at a cost about their preferences between sellers' differentiated products. The incentive for information acquisition depends on the average value of products, the objective product differentiation, and their beliefs about sellers' prices. The acquired information shapes consumers' perceived product differentiation and sellers' equilibrium prices. We characterize the unique symmetric equilibrium and study comparative statics with respect to consumer information acquisition cost and sensitivity to product differentiation. (JEL D43, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了卖方价格竞争与消费者对产品差异化感知之间的均衡互动。我们分析了一种情境，即在交易前，消费者以一定成本获取关于他们在卖方差异化产品之间偏好的信息。信息获取的激励取决于产品的平均价值、客观产品差异化以及他们对卖方价格的信念。所获取的信息塑造了消费者感知的产品差异化和卖方的均衡价格。我们刻画了唯一的对称均衡，并研究了关于消费者信息获取成本和对产品差异化敏感度的比较静态分析。(JEL D43, D82, D83)

articles.title_en: Contracting Environments and Efficiency in Markets with Hidden Information: An Experiment
articles.title_cn: 隐藏信息市场中的契约环境与效率：一项实验
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides the first systematic analysis of the role of contracting environments on market outcomes and efficiency in markets with hidden information using experimental methods. When markets are plagued by hidden information, competition does not necessarily ensure efficient market outcomes. This crucially depends on the nature of the hidden information. We present a parsimonious experimental design that serves to compare the different contracting environments for both types of hidden information markets, private and common values. The degree of equilibrium play that we find is strikingly high, particularly in the complex cases of competitive common values markets. (JEL D82, D86, L15)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次系统性地运用实验方法分析了契约环境在隐藏信息市场中对市场结果和效率的作用。当市场受到隐藏信息困扰时，竞争并不必然确保有效的市场结果。这关键取决于隐藏信息的性质。我们提出了一种简约的实验设计，用以比较私有价值和共同价值两种隐藏信息市场中的不同契约环境。我们发现的均衡行为程度惊人地高，尤其是在竞争性共同价值市场的复杂情形中。(JEL D82, D86, L15)

articles.abstract_en: We consider an ultimatum game where the value of the object being sold to the buyer is high or low. The seller knows the value, but the buyer does not. The value to the seller is zero. We introduce the option for the buyer to acquire costly information after an offer is made. This information either confirms the high value or provides no information. As the cost of information vanishes, the buyer gets all the surplus in a refinement of perfect Bayesian equilibrium, although the option to acquire information is never used. Moreover, this signal structure is optimal for the buyer. (JEL C72, C78, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个最后通牒博弈，其中出售给买方的物品价值可能高或低。卖方知道价值，但买方不知道。卖方价值为零。我们引入买方在报价后获取昂贵信息的选项。该信息要么确认高价值，要么不提供任何信息。随着信息成本趋近于零，在完美贝叶斯均衡的精炼中，买方获得全部剩余，尽管获取信息的选项从未被使用。此外，这种信号结构对买方而言是最优的。(JEL C72, C78, D82, D83)

articles.title_cn: 并购、进入与消费者福利
articles.abstract_en: We model merger-induced entry in the context of differentiated-products price competition. We fully characterize the combinations of merger efficiencies and entrant qualities that can mitigate the adverse equilibrium welfare effects of an otherwise anticompetitive merger. The possibility of merger-induced entry introduces nonmonotonicity into the equilibrium value that consumers receive from merger efficiencies, potentially necessitating the joint analysis of efficiencies and entry in merger review. We also explicitly characterize the efficiencies required for merger-induced entrants to make profitable mergers consumer surplus neutral. We provide an empirical application to the T-Mobile/Sprint merger. (JEL G34, G38, K21, L13, L41)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在差异化产品价格竞争的背景下，对并购引发的进入进行了建模。我们全面刻画了并购效率与进入者质量的组合，这些组合能够缓解原本反竞争的并购对均衡福利的不利影响。并购引发的进入可能性使得消费者从并购效率中获得的均衡价值出现非单调性，这可能要求在并购审查中对效率和进入进行联合分析。我们还明确刻画了使并购引发的进入者能够使盈利性并购对消费者剩余保持中性所需的效率条件。我们提供了一个针对T-Mobile/Sprint并购的实证应用。(JEL G34, G38, K21, L13, L41)

articles.title_en: Church Tax Exemption and Structure of Religious Markets: A Dynamic Structural Analysis
articles.title_cn: 教会免税与宗教市场结构：一项动态结构分析
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of church tax exemptions on the structure of religious markets. Using the Brazilian experience as a showcase, we develop and estimate a dynamic entry model of religious organizations based on temple opening and closure in geographically isolated markets. Counterfactual simulations suggest that tax exemptions stimulated entry by all religions, but disproportionately benefited evangelical denominations: The evangelical share of temples increased by approximately 20 percentage points. By combining difference-in-differences estimates with model-based counterfactuals, we show that these policies also increased the support for evangelical caucus politicians, raising their vote share by 8 percent in the 2018 election. (JEL C73, D43, H25, O15, Z12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了教会免税对宗教市场结构的影响。以巴西的经验为例，我们基于地理隔离市场中的寺庙开设与关闭，开发并估计了一个宗教组织的动态进入模型。反事实模拟表明，免税刺激了所有宗教的进入，但不成比例地惠及了福音派教派：福音派寺庙的份额增加了约20个百分点。通过将差异中的差异估计与基于模型的反事实相结合，我们表明这些政策也增加了对福音派核心小组政客的支持，在2018年选举中将其选票份额提高了8%。(JEL C73, D43, H25, O15, Z12)

articles.title_en: Learning When to Quit: An Empirical Model of Experimentation in Standards Development
articles.title_cn: 学会何时退出：标准制定中实验的实证模型
articles.abstract_en: Using data from the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), a voluntary organization that develops protocols for managing internet infrastructure, we estimate a dynamic discrete choice model of the decision to continue or abandon a line of research. The model's key parameters measure the speed at which authors learn whether their project will become a technology standard. We use the model to simulate two innovation policies: an R&D subsidy and a publication prize. While subsidies have a larger impact on research output, the optimal policy depends on the level of R&D spillovers. (JEL D83, L86, O31, O38)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用互联网工程任务组（IETF）的数据——一个管理互联网基础设施协议的自愿性组织，我们估计了一个动态离散选择模型，用以决定继续或放弃一条研究路线。模型的关键参数衡量了作者了解其项目是否会成为技术标准的速度。我们使用该模型模拟两种创新政策：研发补贴和出版奖励。虽然补贴对研究产出的影响更大，但最优政策取决于研发溢出的水平。（JEL D83, L86, O31, O38）

articles.abstract_en: A firm trades with a sequence of consumers who are unsure about the firm's competence and its effort to supply quality. I examine rating systems that sustain efficient outcomes in virtually all trades by providing consumers with information to motivate a patient-competent firm's effort. I characterize necessary and sufficient conditions for these systems to exist. I show that any such system censors the firm's track records, and explicitly construct one such system. This system reveals that the firm has produced consecutively many good outputs whenever this happens and hides all information otherwise. (JEL D21, D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 一家企业与一系列对其能力和提供质量的努力程度不确定的消费者进行交易。我考察了通过向消费者提供信息以激励有耐心且能干的企业的努力的评级系统，这些系统在几乎所有交易中都能维持有效结果。我刻画了这些系统存在的必要和充分条件。我证明了任何此类系统都会审查企业的过往记录，并明确构建了一个这样的系统。该系统揭示，只要企业连续生产了许多优质产品，就会披露这一信息，否则隐藏所有信息。（JEL D21, D82, D83）

articles.title_cn: 模糊信息下的渐近学习
articles.abstract_en: We study asymptotic learning when the decision-maker faces ambiguity in the precision of her information sources. She aims to estimate a state and evaluates outcomes according to the worst-case scenario. Under prior-by-prior updating, we characterize the set of asymptotic posteriors the decision-maker entertains, which consists of a continuum of degenerate distributions over an interval. Moreover, her asymptotic estimate of the state is generically incorrect. We show that even a small amount of ambiguity may lead to large estimation errors and illustrate how an econometrician who learns from observing others' actions may over- or underreact to information. (JEL D82, D83)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当决策者面临其信息来源精度的模糊性时的渐近学习问题。她旨在估计一个状态，并根据最坏情况评估结果。在先验逐次更新下，我们刻画了决策者所持有的渐近后验集合，该集合由区间上的一系列退化分布组成。此外，她的渐近状态估计通常是不正确的。我们表明，即使是少量的模糊性也可能导致较大的估计误差，并说明了一个从观察他人行为中学习的计量经济学家可能对信息过度反应或反应不足。(JEL D82, D83)

articles.title_en: Free Riding and Unequal Pay in Symmetric Teams
articles.title_cn: 对称团队中的搭便车与不平等薪酬
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies dynamic incentive pay in teams where agents' efforts are perfect substitutes. It shows that the principal may unequally reward identical agents to mitigate dynamic free riding in the form of procrastination. Unequal pay effectively creates a “team leader” who overworks and symmetric “followers” who underwork. Such leader-follower teams emerge if (i) agents are relatively patient or few, or (ii) the principal sufficiently cares about or is not patient for project success. These findings contrast with the recent literature (e.g., Winter 2004), pinpointing effort complementarity as the source of unequal pay in symmetric teams. (JEL D82, J22, J31, M52)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了团队成员努力为完全替代品时的动态激励薪酬。研究表明，委托人可能对相同的代理人给予不平等的报酬，以缓解以拖延形式出现的动态搭便车行为。不平等的薪酬有效地创造了一个过度工作的“团队领导者”和对称的“跟随者”工作不足。这种领导者-跟随者团队的出现条件是：(i) 代理人相对有耐心或人数较少，或 (ii) 委托人足够关心项目成功或对项目成功不够耐心。这些发现与近期文献（如Winter 2004）形成对比，指出努力互补性是导致对称团队中不平等薪酬的根源。(JEL D82, J22, J31, M52)

articles.title_en: Monitoring Team Members: Information Waste and the Transparency Trap
articles.title_cn: 监控团队成员：信息浪费与透明度陷阱
articles.abstract_en: In a model of moral hazard in teams, we demonstrate that firms' concerns about low trust among teammates can justify two common but otherwise puzzling patterns: information waste and transparency trap. We find firms predominantly employ individual performance bonuses, ignoring that relevant information about team output and competition for better contracts leads workers into a self-defeating race toward effort transparency. Notably, the firm may be indifferent to or benefit from trust concerns, challenging the idea that robustness concerns invariably harm the principal's payoffs. Our analysis highlights a novel trade-off between the classical information rents and strategic insurance rents emerging from trust concerns. (JEL D21, D82, D86, J33, M54)
articles.abstract_cn: 在团队道德风险模型中，我们证明企业对团队成员间低信任度的担忧可以解释两种常见但令人费解的现象：信息浪费和透明度陷阱。我们发现企业主要采用个人绩效奖金，忽视了关于团队产出和更好合同竞争的相关信息导致工人陷入自我挫败的努力透明度竞赛。值得注意的是，企业可能对信任担忧无动于衷或从中受益，这挑战了稳健性担忧总是损害委托人收益的观点。我们的分析突出了经典信息租金与由信任担忧产生的战略保险租金之间的新颖权衡。（JEL D21, D82, D86, J33, M54）

articles.title_en: Competition and Defaults in Online Search
articles.title_cn: 在线搜索中的竞争与默认设置
articles.abstract_en: This paper offers the first systematic quantitative assessment of default-option interventions designed to mitigate Google's search dominance. By analyzing interventions in the European Economic Area (EEA), Russia, and Turkey, we find that across all three cases, changes to default settings effectively reduced Google's market share. The causal impact amounts to less than 1 percentage point in the EEA and over 10 percentage points in Russia and Turkey. Differences arise from intervention nuances, including the size of the targeted users' group, local market characteristics, and remedy designs. We discuss the complexity of assessing the interventions' impact on welfare deriving from quality responses. (JEL G34, K21, L13, L82, O14, P31)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次对旨在缓解谷歌搜索主导地位的默认选项干预措施进行了系统的定量评估。通过分析欧洲经济区（EEA）、俄罗斯和土耳其的干预措施，我们发现在这三个案例中，默认设置的变更均有效降低了谷歌的市场份额。因果影响在EEA中不足1个百分点，而在俄罗斯和土耳其则超过10个百分点。差异源于干预措施的细微差别，包括目标用户群体的规模、当地市场特征以及补救设计。我们讨论了评估这些干预措施对源于质量反应的福利影响的复杂性。（JEL G34, K21, L13, L82, O14, P31）

articles.abstract_en: Labor markets unravel when workers and firms match inefficiently early under limited information. I argue that a significant determinant of unraveling is the presence of a secondary market, where firms can poach workers, and its transparency: how well firms can ascertain workers' value once they are employed by competitors. While early hiring reduces the probability of hiring a high-type worker, it prevents rivals from learning about the worker, making poaching difficult. When secondary markets are very transparent, unraveling disappears. However, the matching remains inefficient due to the incentives of low-tier firms to communicate that they have not hired top-quality workers. (JEL C78, D47, J23, J44, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 当工人和企业在信息有限的情况下过早地进行低效匹配时，劳动力市场就会出现“解开”现象。我认为，解开现象的一个重要决定因素是次级市场的存在及其透明度，即企业能否在工人被竞争对手雇佣后准确评估其价值。虽然过早招聘降低了雇佣高能力工人的概率，但它阻止了竞争对手了解工人，从而使挖角变得困难。当次级市场非常透明时，解开现象消失。然而，由于低层级企业有动机传达他们并未雇佣顶尖工人的信息，匹配仍然低效。（JEL C78, D47, J23, J44, M51）

articles.title_en: Asymmetric Players in a Meritocracy: A Case for Affirmative Action
articles.title_cn: 精英体制中的不对称参与者：平权行动的一个案例
articles.abstract_en: We model decisions to apply for college admission, attend job auditions, or run for C-suite positions as costly entry into meritocracies, where the entrant with the highest ability wins a reward. Ability is privately known and players generically differ in commonly known characteristics such as ability distributions, entry costs, or payoffs from winning. Any infinitesimal difference leads to wildly different equilibrium entry probabilities, explaining large dispersion in representation of comparable but nonidentical population groups. Affirmative action policies such as handicapping advantaged players or surcharging them to subsidize disadvantaged players increase participation rates of disadvantaged players and, in return, increase social welfare. (JEL D82, J15, J16, J22, K31, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们模拟了申请大学入学、参加求职面试或竞选高管职位的决策，将其视为进入精英体制的高成本行为，在这种体制中，能力最高的进入者赢得奖励。能力是私人信息，参与者在通常已知的特征上普遍存在差异，如能力分布、进入成本或获胜收益。任何微小的差异都会导致截然不同的均衡进入概率，这解释了可比但不同质的人口群体在代表性上的巨大差异。平权行动政策，如对优势参与者设置障碍或对其额外收费以补贴劣势参与者，提高了劣势参与者的参与率，并因此增加了社会福利。(JEL D82, J15, J16, J22, K31, M51)
